title: Remediate full code sweep findings
summary: Remediates accepted coordinator findings COORD-001 through COORD-009 across rerun integrity, degraded-state handling, strict command intent, transactional mutation, path/profile authority, evidence completeness, public contracts, and pending-publish ownership.
reason: The full-code-sweep coordinator verified release-critical corruption and cross-tab safety/contract defects that could permit unsafe defaults, conceal unavailable evidence, lose rollback guarantees, or let frontend/cache state overstate backend authority.
behavior_before: Rerun policy source could not import; malformed persisted state could be treated as absent or safe; kill/start intent was underspecified; several mutations lacked strict transaction, CAS, fingerprint, or path-boundary guarantees; capped/cache evidence obscured completeness; and the WebView applied pending-drain eligibility policy.
behavior_after: Rerun policy imports and executes with verified source integrity; malformed or unavailable state fails closed; backend contracts require literal destructive intent and explicit start mode; repair/network/settings/rename/profile mutations preserve rollback and authority; metrics/reports/completed payloads expose independent health and completeness; queue/network contracts align; and backend/PowerShell exclusively decide pending-publish recovery and drain eligibility.
tests_added: Added and extended adverse-path Python tests for NUL/import integrity, malformed overrides and progress, strict kill/start payload rejection, repair journal rollback, network join compensation, settings CAS conflicts, rename fingerprint/root/undo boundaries, profile promotion cleanup, completed parse health, capped report blockers, and metrics completeness.
Added browser refresh-transition coverage for Metrics and extended Home, Reports, Pending Publish, and Rename browser/static coverage for fail-closed recovery and backend-owned command evidence.
Extended PowerShell unit checks for malformed file overrides, LibraryProfiles path safety, and explicit pending-publish recovery separation and journaling.
